input: select a,b from t left join z on t.id=z.id where z.x=1 group by a having a>1 order by b limit 1 offset 2
output:

from
    t

    z
on
    t.id=z.id
where
    z.x=1
group by
    a
having
    a>1
order by
    b
limit
    1
offset
    2
